text: {"original_span": "The measured PGR falls below the baseline, so this run provides no evidence that label dropout helps; with only two seeds and a PGR standard error of 0.17, the estimate is also too imprecise to characterize the apparent shortfall with confidence.", "new_span": "The measured PGR falls well below the baseline, and the gap is large relative to the PGR standard error of 0.17, indicating that label dropout reliably hurts weak-to-strong generalization here.", "flaw_type": "c", "metric": "pgr_se", "why": "With 2 seeds and SE 0.17, the 0.27 shortfall is not statistically reliable, so the certainty claim is unsupported."}
